pick.headline: Guerrillas attack La Tablada barracks in Argentina
pick.summary: On 23 January 1989 members of the leftist Movimiento Todos por la Patria attacked the army barracks at La Tablada near Buenos Aires; the army retook it after over a day of fighting.
pick.significance: The bloody attack, the last of its kind in Argentina, strengthened the military's hand against the civilian government of Raul Alfonsin.

evidence.snippet: …os Aires NOTICIAS ARGENTINAS in Spanish 1009 GMT 23 Jan 89 [Text] Buenos Aires, 23 Jan (NA)}—This morning at 0630 a group of unknown persons reportedly attacked the installations of the 3d Infantry Regiment, based in La Tablada [Buenos Aires City].
